bullets.text: Union Busting at Rockstar Games - **Rockstar Games** faces accusations of union busting after firing 30-40 employees linked to a union.
Apple Music's Hidden Feature - **Apple Music** in iOS 26 introduces pinned music with a custom 'Tap Action' feature.
Samsung Galaxy XR Impresses - **Samsung's** Galaxy XR headset offers a unique blend of augmented reality and comfort.
Baseus EnerGeek GX11 Review - The **EnerGeek GX11** power bank doubles as a cellular hotspot, offering 4G connectivity.
Apple TV's New Drama Series - **Apple TV** launches 'Down Cemetery Road' to keep subscribers engaged post 'Slow Horses'.
CarPlay Gets Widgets - **iOS 26** introduces widgets to **CarPlay**, enhancing user experience with glanceable information.
Meta's Solar Power Push - **Meta** procures nearly 1 gigawatt of solar power to support its AI ambitions.
AWS Surpasses Expectations - **AWS** reports strong growth driven by high demand for cloud infrastructure in AI.
Hackers Breach University of Pennsylvania - Hackers threaten to leak data after breaching the **University of Pennsylvania**'s systems.
Tim Cook on AI M&A - **Apple's** Tim Cook expresses openness to acquisitions to advance AI initiatives.
